en: Storm surge season is almost over: Hardly any damage – the coast and islands are defying storm surges. Eight light storm surges hit the coast in the winter, but there were no major sand losses on the East Frisian Islands. Lower Saxony still wants to invest a lot of money in island protection.
la: Tempestas impetus temporum propemodum est: vix noxa ulla est - oram et insulae procellae fluctuat. Tempestas levis octo aestuat oram hieme in ledo, sed nullae majores harenae in insulis Frisiis Orientalibus damna sunt. Saxonia inferioris multum pecuniae in tutela insulae collocare adhuc vult.
